mapper.select: select a.*, b.SN as sn,b.MODEL_ID as modelId,b.PROCESS_INSTANCE_ID as processInstanceId,b.STATUS as status, b.APPLY_UNIT as applyUnit,b.APPLY_NAME as applyName,b.KP_SN as kpSn,b.HT_PROJECT_NAME as htProjectName, b.HT_CONTRACT_NO as htContractNo, c.PURCHASER as purchaser,c.HT_COMPANY_OR_DEPARTMENT as htCompanyOrDepartment,c.HT_OWNER as htOwner from BIZ_INVOICE_COST_BILL a join BIZ_INVOICE_COST b on a.INVOICE_COST_ID = b.ID left join BIZ_INVOICE_SALE c on b.KP_SN = c.SN and c.DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and c.STATUS in ('0','1') ${ew.customSqlSegment}
